name: Shallow March
description: Shallow March was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Mortex sector. It hosted the Shallow March Supply Post of the Galactic Empire, with the facility being under the command of Major Tarn Innis beginning around 4 BBY. At one point, Innis, who supplied military units of both the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, fended off the planet's predators via the use of grenades while providing supplies for the Alliance officer Airen Cracken.
